precision, grouped quantization settings, and kernel hints.n- workload: a production-style request distribution (prompt templates length distribution sampling params).n- safety validator: a gate that runs automated checks comparing quantized outputs to the float32 baseline.nnhigh-level workflow (autotune validation)n1. create workload bundle: collect 5005,000 representative prompts, length histogram, and desired sampling params (top_p, temp, max_tokens). store as a named bundle: e.g., workload/email-reply-v1.n2. generate candidate quant profiles: run the autotuner (see cli example) across target precisions and per-layer candidates. save candidates with consistent ids.n3. run fast validators: run lightweight metrics (embedding similarity, token-level edit distance, logit shift) over 1k samples. reject obviously broken candidates.n4. run heavy validators: full pass through regression harness semantic metrics, downstream evals, latency/cost benchmarks.n5. safety decision: accept, accept-with-fallback, or reject. if accepted, create staged rollout with fallback policy.n6. monitor: collect production metrics during rollout (regression alerts, user-quality signals). revert if thresholds breach.nnautotune commands and examplesn- basic autotune run (local/gke job):n rwd-quant-autotune --model-id gptx-13b --workload ./bundles/email-reply-v1.json --min-precision6 fast_embed(fp32_out) 0.995 on mean across samples.n- top-token overlap: greedy(top1 list) overlap 0.90 for prompts shorter than 64 tokens.n- aggregate logit shift: mean absolute logit shift per-token 95 (within labeling noise).n- embedding stability for retrieval: mean cosine similarity 0.98 and map@10 degradation 30 semantic distance (measured via embedding entailment).n- latency/cost improvement is observed or neutral (cost per 1k tokens reduced by at least 5 or within /-3).n- no increase in variance of per-request latency 2x baseline.nnif not accepted, the actionable outcomes:n- reject: keep fp32 in production and log candidate for analysis.n- accept-with-fallback: deploy profile behind rollout where fallback is the fp32 flow if logit-shift 0.2 or if per-request quality signal fires.n- conditional: enable for read-only endpoints (embeddings, reranking) but not for generative-chat endpoints.nnrollout plan (staged)n1. canary: 1 traffic, shadow requests to fp32, monitor for 48h.n2. embedding_similarity_distribution,n - token_edit_distance_histogram,n - p50/p95 latency and cost-per-token.nn- real-time alert thresholds:n - embedding similarity median critical alert.n - task-specific metric drop delta (see heavy validators) critical.n - production-per-request logit shift 0.3 for 0.1 of requests in 5m warning.nnregression harness (automation)n- inputs: candidate title: probe-driven fidelity lattice and quant hedging playbook, content: overview:nnthis playbook defines a practical, probe-driven approach for managing a fidelity lattice (a graded set of model quantization / execution modes) and an automated hedging policy that routes traffic, triggers fallbacks, and controls rollouts. it is intended for model-onboarding engineers, sres supporting inference fleets, and evaluation teams responsible for quality regressions during quant migration.nngoals:n- reduce per-token cost by opportunistically using lower-fidelity execution while maintaining user-facing quality slos.n- detect and contain fidelity-induced regressions early using probes and live-slice telemetry.n- provide deterministic rollback and hedging rules that integrate with canary/a/b and dedicated/private deployments.nnscope and assumptions:n- applies to sequence generation models (chat, completions, rerankers) served by the redwood runtime.n- assumes model artifacts have at least two quantization variants (baseline_fp16/fp32, quant8/aq8, and a low-memory int4-like option).n- requires probe infrastructure (eval harness shadow runs, slice tagging, and real-time quality sensors) already configured per service.nnkey concepts:n1) fidelity lattice: an ordered list of model variants by fidelity and cost. example lattice levels: highest - baseline_fp16, medium - quant8, low - int4_sparse.n2) probe cohort: a lightweight, representative probe set for a service slice (user intent cluster) used to surface coherence/regression signals during shadow and live checks.n3) hedging policy: pre-authorized rules that route live traffic to fallback fidelity levels (or alternate models) when telemetry crosses thresholds.n4) safety envelope: slos, noise budgets, and automated conditions under which a rollout must pause or roll back.nnfidelity lattice (example table):n level variant id expected latency delta token-cost ratio expected coherence impact owner n------:---:---:------n highest m-xl-baseline-fp16 0 ms 1.00x baseline model-onboard-team n medium m-xl-quant8 -12 0.62x small risk (templated answers) runtime-ops n low m-xl-int4-sparse -28 0.38x medium risk (hallucination/formatting) runtime-ops nnquality and telemetry signals to monitor:n- probe pass rate (primary): fraction of probe inputs where the fidelity variant matches baseline acceptance criteria (semantic match configured threshold).n- drift score: embedding similarity change vs baseline on anchor prompts.n- latency tail (p95, p99) and token-level throughput differential.n- functioncall fidelity: percentage of function calls with parsed arguments matching ground truth.n- regression surface: rate of new failure slices (per 10k requests) compared to baseline.n- cost delta: observed per-token spend change vs baseline window.nnrelease criteria (pre-flight checklist):n- unit tests and model verification complete (see onboarding-checklist).n- shadow run against representative probe cohort for 2472 hours with:n - probe pass rate 99 for medium, 95 for low (adjust per service risk).n - no new high-severity slice with 1 traffic exposure.n - latency tail within configured slo increase (default p95 medium hedged traffic for canary (sampled 1)n - expand to 5 if 24h shadow probes passn2. real-time triggers (immediate action):n - if probe pass rate drops by 2.5 percentage points vs rolling baseline - immediate shift to previous lattice level for affected slices and create incident with severity p2.n - if new regression slice rate 0.5 for traffic-weighted slices - pause expansion and throttle to 50 of target.n3. escalation windows (if degraded but not catastrophic):n - after 30 minutes of degraded probe pass rate, revert to baseline for the slice, trigger auto-bisect job, and open a triage ticket.nnrunbook: responding to a hedging triggern1. triage owner assignment: runtime-ops oncall (first 15min), then model-onboard lead if root cause is model/quant.n2. immediate mitigation:n - execute automated rollback: set route override to previous fidelity level for impacted slice (cli example below).n - notify slo dashboard channel and oncall pager.n3. collect artifacts (automated):n - shadow logs for affected requests (include seed, tokenization, kv hit/miss).n - probe-level diffs and embedding drift snapshots.n - quantization
